00086 class ExternalControlSourceInternal : public SmartPointer
00087 {
00088 public:
00089   
00092   
00093   ExternalControlSourceInternal(const float minVal = 0.f, const float maxVal = 127.f, 
00094                   const ExternalControlSource::Warp warp = ExternalControlSource::Linear) throw()
00095   : value(minVal), minVal_(minVal), maxVal_(maxVal), warp_(warp) { }
00096   
00098   
00101   
00102   inline float getValue() const throw()       { return value;   }
00103   inline const float* getValuePtr() const throw()   { return &value;  }
00104   inline void setValue(const float newValue) throw()  { value = newValue; }
00105   inline void setNormalisedValue(float value0_1) throw()
00106   {
00107     switch(warp_)
00108     {
00109       case ExternalControlSource::Linear:
00110         value = value0_1 * (maxVal_ - minVal_) + minVal_;
00111         break;
00112       case ExternalControlSource::Exponential:
00113         value = minVal_ * pow(maxVal_ / minVal_, value0_1);
00114         break;
00115     }
00116   }
00117   
00119   
00120   friend class ExternalControlSourceUGenInternal;
00121   
00122 protected:
00123   float value;
00124   float minVal_;
00125   float maxVal_;
00126   ExternalControlSource::Warp warp_;
00127 };
